template.name: Template

query.formula: simulate [<=100; 5] { error_a, t_a} // Room A error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 50] { error_b, t_b } // Room B error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 50] { error_c, t_c } // Room C error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 50] { error_d, t_d } // Room D error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 50] { error_e, t_e } // Room E error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 50] { error_d, t_f } // Room F error/temp with random controller
simulate [<=100; 10] { error_a, error_b, error_c, error_d, error_e, error_f} // All Rooms error with random controller
simulate [<=100; 10] { t_a, t_b, t_c, t_d, t_e, t_f} // All Rooms temps with random controller
strategy opt_a = minE (error_a) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room A
strategy opt_b = minE (error_b) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room B
strategy opt_c = minE (error_c) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room C
strategy opt_d = minE (error_d) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room D
strategy opt_e = minE (error_e) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room E
strategy opt_f = minE (error_f) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize error of Room F
strategy opt_total = minE (error_acum) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Minimize cumulative error of all Rooms
strategy opt_total_act_wear = minE (error_acum) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 40 // Minimize cumulative error with actuator wear of all Rooms
strategy max_t_a = maxE (t_a) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room A
strategy max_t_b = maxE (t_b) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room B
strategy max_t_c = maxE (t_c) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room C
strategy max_t_d = maxE (t_d) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room D
strategy max_t_e = maxE (t_e) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room E
strategy max_t_f = maxE (t_f) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of Room F
strategy max_t_avg = maxE (t_avg) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Max temp of all Rooms
strategy min_t_a = minE (t_a) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room A
strategy min_t_b = minE (t_b) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room B
strategy min_t_c = minE (t_c) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room C
strategy min_t_d = minE (t_d) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room D
strategy min_t_e = minE (t_e) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room E
strategy min_t_f = minE (t_f) [<=100] : <> global_time >= 100 // Min temp of Room F
